title: Top 5 BIGGEST Stars In The Universe
hook: Number one is so vast that over 10 billion Suns could fit inside it.

items.name: Antares
items.stat: This red supergiant is about 700 times the Sun's radius and 10,000 times brighter.

items.name: Betelgeuse
items.stat: About 760 times the Sun's radius — if placed here, it would engulf Mars's orbit.

items.name: VY Canis Majoris
items.stat: A hypergiant around 1,400 times the Sun's radius, once thought the largest known star.

items.name: WOH G64
items.stat: This dusty supergiant spans roughly 1,540 times the Sun's radius in the Large Magellanic Cloud.

items.name: Stephenson 2-18
items.stat: About 2,150 times the Sun's radius — over 10 billion Suns could fit inside it.
